description: Calculate historical-simulation VaR and expected shortfall for the verified current linear book using 20-500 caller-supplied daily return rows. Refuses nonlinear or incomplete books and never moves money.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

observations.description: Daily close-to-close returns for every verified linear delta asset.

asset_returns_pct.description: Canonical asset symbols mapped to bounded percentage changes.

date.description: Unique UTC observation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: preview_historical_portfolio_risk
